text: I am writing this letter with sincere regret to apologize for being unable to attend tomorrow's academic symposium on modern linguistics as previously scheduled.
Much to my distress, our laboratory has just been assigned an emergency national research task, and I am designated to handle critical experimental data analysis under an extremely tight deadline.
Because of this unanticipated circumstance, it is utterly impossible for me to be absent from the laboratory tomorrow.
I fully realize the inconvenience and disappointment my unexpected absence may cause to you and the research group.
Would it be possible for us to reschedule our meeting for next Tuesday?
Please accept my deepest apologies once again for this regrettable situation.
